subject.title: fix(mattermost): key private channels as group on outbound routing

question: Should bound-session preservation be introduced as a generic, opt-in channel route contract owned by the Mattermost plugin, rather than as a Mattermost condition in shared cron dispatch?
rationale: The bug needs the bound conversation identity, but choosing the durable cross-plugin contract is an owner-boundary decision that cannot safely be encoded as a one-off core exception.

options.title: Add a generic plugin opt-in seam
options.body: Keep core provider-agnostic and let Mattermost explicitly request use of a validated bound session identity for its outbound route reconstruction.

options.title: Approve the narrow core exception
options.body: Accept the Mattermost-specific branch in cron as an intentional exception and document why no generic plugin contract is appropriate.

recommendation.title: Add a generic plugin opt-in seam
recommendation.body: Keep core provider-agnostic and let Mattermost explicitly request use of a validated bound session identity for its outbound route reconstruction.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation across both the Mattermost and cron sides, though current-main ownership remains unverified.
